invariants.rationale: The method is invoked with an Order instance, and most realistic uses would expect a non-null order argument.
Order quantity is typically non-negative, representing the count of items in an order.
Unit price in sales is usually non-negative.
The getQuantity method likely returns the backing quantity field based on naming.
The getUnitPrice method likely returns the unitPrice field; this is inferred from typical Java bean patterns.
